category_title: Students who engage in off-task behavior to obtain teacher and peer attention
minimal_context: Jose is assigned to complete a worksheet at his desk during independent work time in his fourth-grade classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jose, it is time for independent work. Please complete this worksheet at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet aside and starts playing with books and materials on his desk.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your seatwork right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves his desk and walks across the classroom to sharpen his pencil.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go back to your assigned area and finish the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Instead of returning to his desk, he moves around the classroom, talking to peers and interrupting other students who are working.)

dialogue_combined:
